commit.subject: ci(worker-image): build on pull_request so the check follows every PR head

changes: .github/workflows/worker-image.yaml: the `push` trigger is replaced by `pull_request` (branches: [main]; types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]; the same three paths: packages/daemon/docker/**, packages/daemon/src/daemon/omp-pin.ts, .github/workflows/worker-image.yaml). GitHub evaluates pull_request paths against the whole PR diff, so every head of a PR touching the image gets the check.

.github/workflows/worker-image.yaml: job env `BUILT_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}` — the PR head on pull_request (github.sha is the ephemeral merge commit there), the triggering commit on workflow_call/workflow_dispatch. actions/checkout takes `ref: ${{ env.BUILT_SHA }}`; `Compute tags` derives `short` from BUILT_SHA and emits a `built_sha` output; the OCI `org.opencontainers.image.revision` label uses that output instead of github.sha.

.github/workflows/worker-image.yaml: concurrency group `worker-image-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}` so two pushes to one PR serialize on the PR number; workflow_call/dispatch keep the ref key.

.github/workflows/worker-image.yaml: comments updated (pre-merge trigger rationale; permissions note that same-repo pull_request runs get id-token/packages/contents write — a fork PR would get a read-only token and this repo takes no fork PRs). Version tag / release edit remain gated on GITHUB_REF == refs/heads/main with a non-empty cli_version, so a PR run publishes sha- only.

docs/kubernetes.md: trigger (2) is now 'every head of a pull request against main whose diff touches …', with the push-vs-pull_request rationale, the same-repo permissions note, and the tag line clarifying sha- names the built commit (the PR head). Iteration text: 'pushing the PR branch'.
